title: Memos and consignment out
summary: Send goods to a customer on memo, invoice what they keep, and take back the rest.

steps.text: Open {co} from the sidebar and click {new} to start a memo for the customer receiving the goods.
Add a line for each item you are sending, then click {issue}. The items stay in your stock, marked as on memo, until the customer buys them or sends them back.
When the goods leave, tick their lines on the memo and choose Set as shipped from the line actions. Only shipped lines can be invoiced.

When the customer keeps some items, tick those lines and choose Invoice selected. Check the preview, then confirm to put them on a new draft invoice or one you already have. Invoice all puts everything still out on one draft invoice.
When items come back, tick their lines and choose Set as available. They return to your stock as available to sell.
The totals on the memo show what each invoice took and what is still on memo. Once nothing is out, click Close. A closed memo can be reopened.
